scripts/installer_support.py

Python · Tier B

Standard-library-only consent, progress and logs for source installation.

Usage

Called by the source dependency updater after consent.

Inputs

Commands, optional step labels and the verbose output flag.

Side effects

Executes commands, captures quiet output in private temporary logs, and shows step progress on stderr with animation only on capable terminals.

Cleanup

Joins progress threads on completion/interruption; keeps failed logs.
